name: Network Congestion
description: The human operator's network connection may be congested, leading to variable analysis times.

name: Network Connection
description: The quality of the network connection between the UAV and the human operator may vary, affecting analysis times.

name: Human Operator Workload
description: The human operator's workload may fluctuate, affecting their ability to analyze images quickly.

name: UAV Onboard Computer Resources
description: The UAV's onboard computer resources may be limited, affecting the performance of the image classifier.

name: Image Classifier Efficiency
description: The efficiency of the onboard image classifier may vary due to factors such as software updates or hardware changes.

name: Data Preprocessing
description: The time required for data preprocessing may vary depending on the type of image and the efficiency of the onboard computer.

name: Power Management
description: The UAV's power management system may affect the performance of the onboard computer, leading to variable analysis times.

name: Battery Health
description: The health of the UAV's battery may affect its performance, leading to variable analysis times.

name: Weather Conditions
description: Weather conditions such as turbulence or precipitation may affect the UAV's ability to take clear images, leading to variable analysis times.

name: Lighting Conditions
description: The lighting conditions at each waypoint may vary, affecting the quality of the images taken.

name: Camera Settings
description: The camera settings used by the UAV may vary, affecting the quality of the images taken.

name: Sensor Degradation
description: The degradation of the UAV's sensors over time may affect the quality of the images taken, leading to variable analysis times.

name: Maintenance Schedule
description: The maintenance schedule of the UAV may affect the performance of its sensors, leading to variable analysis times.

name: Sensor Calibration
description: The calibration of the UAV's sensors may vary, affecting the quality of the images taken.

name: Route Planning
description: The route planning algorithm may affect the sequence of waypoints visited by the UAV, leading to variable analysis times.
